note: Every path adopt seeds into a project and tracks in the manifest. An entry ending in / expands to every file under it, so a file landing on another branch joins this list when it lands. The three bin/ entries are named one by one because bin/adopt is this template's own tool and does not belong in a project it seeded. CLAUDE.md is absent on purpose: this repository's copy describes agentkit itself, and the skeleton a project gets has no issue yet.
